transcript: Mareez mardat, 28 saal. 5 din se tez bukhar hai. Sar datar kamzori bhi hai. Cairn dard nahi. Rahat nahi. Bhook thand lagide. Ulti nahi hai. Dastry nahi. Typhoid ka test twice a day. Azomax paanch ml rozana. Rencoli 7 din. Paradal do goli din mein teen baar. jab bukhar ho, 3 din. baad dobara hai.

medications.name: Azomax
medications.instructions: continue for 3 days if fever persists
